applicabilityBasis.summary: Polymarket documents pUSD as the collateral token used for all trading on its platform and as its technical settlement layer, which is a payment or settlement design. Published wrapping and unwrapping run only between pUSD and USDC.e on Polygon through admin-pausable contracts, and section 2(22) of the GENIUS Act requires an issuer obligation to convert, redeem or repurchase for a fixed amount of monetary value while excluding a digital asset denominated in a fixed amount of monetary value from that limb, which section 2(17) confines to national currency or deposits. The opened disclosures name no legal pUSD issuer or redemption obligor, so the statutory issuer obligation element is unresolved and applicability remains unclear.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-28. Polymarket docs document USDC and USDC.e backing enforced by the CollateralOnramp and CollateralOfframp contracts with a shared administrative pause gate, and no doc names a legal pUSD issuer; the platform terms page did not expose substantive terms in this review, so no issuerEntity is supplied. Press reporting from July 2025 described internal deliberations about a platform stablecoin before pUSD launched in April 2026, which is not an issuer GENIUS pathway disclosure for this token, and the tracker directs the more conservative status where statuses are torn. Circle USDC authorizations and NYDFS listings belong to the underlying asset and are not inherited by this wrapper. No exact token public GENIUS approval, application, state qualification, foreign registration or enforcement action was found in the checked sources, and GENIUS remains pre-effective in the reviewed primary sources.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: On 2026-10-28 the OCC digital asset licensing table listed unrelated bank and trust applicants, the Federal Register search for Polymarket returned one unrelated CFTC proposed rule on FCM conflicts that cites a news article about market liquidity, and the Federal Reserve 2026 press index, the FDIC press listing and the NYDFS regulated entity and greenlist tables contained no pUSD or Polymarket entry. No public qualifying GENIUS approval, application, state qualification or registered foreign exception naming this token or its issuer was found. The exact legal issuer is unresolved, so this is a bounded public evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished filing exists.
